title: 31. How do I add or remove possible answers in choice questions?
intent: This article helps EUSurvey survey managers understand or perform the task: How do I add or remove possible answers in choice questions.
short_answer: You can add or remove possible answers by clicking the plus/minus button in the Element properties pane. Edit the text of the existing answer options by clicking the pen icon next to 'Possible answers'. You can then edit them in the rich text editor.
procedure: See also 'How do I create a questionnaire via the EUSurvey editor?'
